figures.claim: 1. Figure 1: Overview of the INLP-projected linear probing pipeline for cross-subject EEG foundation model transfer. Raw EEG signals undergo Euclidean Alignment (EA) before being processed by a frozen CBraMod encoder. The resulting embeddings are projected through Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP) to remove linearly decodable subject identity, then classified by a linear head. The LOSO protocol trains on 8 subjects and tests on the held-out subject.
figures.explanation: Analysis stage: The described 4-stage pipeline is directly verifiable from static code inspection: (1) EA preprocessing in exp/project/data/load_bnci.py (euclidean_alignment function), (2) frozen CBraMod embedding in exp/project/data/extract_embeddings.py, (3) INLP projection in exp/project/methods/inlp.py (run_inlp/run_inlp_progressive), (4) linear classification in exp/project/evaluation/loso_eval.py (LogisticRegression). LOSO protocol with 8 training subjects and 1 held-out is implemented in loso_eval.py. The pipeline description is qualitative and fully consistent with the code.

figures.claim: 2. Figure 2: Distribution of INLP hyperparameter selections across 27 LOSO folds (9 subjects × 3 seeds). (a) Inner cross-validation predominantly selects 1–3 INLP iterations (77.8% of folds), indicating minimal intervention is optimal. (b) The weak regularization setting C = 0.01 is selected in 92.6% of folds, further limiting the aggressiveness of nullspace removal.
figures.explanation: Analysis stage: The underlying data for Figure 2 is directly verifiable from exp/EXPERIMENT_RESULTS/optimize_trace/iteration_0/inlp_optimized.csv and RESULTS.json. From the CSV (27 rows), counting best_n_iter: iter=1 (7 folds), iter=2 (8 folds, including 1 with C=0.1), iter=3 (6 folds) → 21/27 = 77.78% ≈ 77.8%. For C=0.01: 25/27 = 92.59% ≈ 92.6%. The config_selection.distribution in RESULTS.json confirms the same counts. The inlp_optimized.csv contains realistic execution timing data (1269–1478s per fold for INLP, 863–913s for CV) supporting it as a genuine execution artifact.
